Member 1 is a 29-year-old woman, university-educated and working as a hospital physiotherapist in inner-city Melbourne. She lives with her partner in a rented two-bedroom apartment, and they are a dual-income, no-kids couple who share a rescue dog. She is an ENFJ, socially confident, community-minded, and often the one organizing gatherings, yet she describes herself as internally anxious and prone to depressive episodes. She manages a diagnosed attention condition with routines, mental checklists, and weekly inbox clearing. She is a cautious risk-taker, consensus-driven in decisions, and deeply values family, wealth, personal freedom, adventure, tradition, community, spirituality, social status, and privacy. Her politics are centrist and secular, and she is skeptical of free markets and government regulation alike. She works hybrid shifts, commutes by public transit, is always early, and keeps a weekly planning horizon. She is cost-sensitive but an impulse buyer, prefers cash and Apple devices, uses Chrome, X, and Telegram, and has a small number of subscriptions. She reads daily, streams little, never games, drinks tea instead of coffee, and has a rushed morning routine. She sleeps irregularly, exercises monthly, eats flexitarian, never drinks alcohol or smokes, and has good health with a managed chronic condition and mild motion sensitivity. Her close relationships can be complicated: she is loyal, honest, kind, fair, playful, and spiritual, but has low sympathy and empathy, so she often helps through practical action and community building rather than emotional attunement. She is highly extraverted yet an ambivert in social battery, prefers one-on-one depth, gives every detail, and leans toward change. At home she is not highly conscientious, so her partner often handles the administrative side of their DINK life.

Member 2 is a 31-year-old man, also university-educated, working as a clinical psychologist and telehealth consultant in inner-city Melbourne. He is an ENFP, inventive, artistic, devoutly religious, and highly intuitive, with a strong need for learning and cognition. He is the more directive and competitive partner, though he prefers to support rather than lead in groups; he works remotely when possible, keeps traditional 9-to-5 hours, and usually commutes by car. He is a night owl, usually late, high caffeine, daily cook, tidy, and frugal overall despite occasional impulse buys. He has an excellent general health rating but struggles with mental health, manages a medical dietary restriction, has reduced manual dexterity, and mild attention differences. He values health, power and influence, achievement, creativity, social status, independence, and helping others. His politics are apolitical, but he favors government regulation, free markets, nuclear energy, homeownership, and electric vehicles, while being skeptical of climate action, new technology, consumerism, fast fashion, and urban density. He is risk-averse in high-stakes financial and ethical matters yet excitement-seeking socially, and he is an early adopter in some lifestyle areas while avoiding most complex tech. He uses mixed devices, Chrome, YouTube, and WhatsApp, prefers cash and a traditional bank, has few subscriptions, and streams 8 to 15 hours a week. He reads monthly, listens to music sometimes, cooks daily, stretches daily, meditates monthly, and never volunteers or donates. He is deeply attached to his partner but experiences high attachment anxiety and negative emotionality. As a DINK household member, he is enthusiastic about buying a townhouse, saving frugally, and building a beautiful, health-focused home, though he remains skeptical of urban density and conventional tech-driven productivity.
